Parliamentary panel suggests NEET exam reforms amid paper leak concerns

A parliamentary panel has recommended significant reforms for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) exam, including the implementation of digital question banks and a shift towards computer-based testing (CBT). The panel also suggested last-minute paper setting and the appointment of experts to ensure examination integrity. The report emphasizes the need for a system where all involved, from the Director General to invigilators, act as guardians of the exam's credibility. Rebuilding public trust, the panel stated, requires consistent, transparent, and two-way communication with stakeholders.
